entries.name: Ironlink's Core

entries.description: Parrying with a 1H Sword and empty off-hand triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and MP recovery.
entries.name: Crimson Riposte

entries.description: Defines your modal pet stance: Glacial Tusker (Wild Raaz / Cehuetzi) anchors bosses with heavy pet durability, AoE/conal immunity, threat forwarding, and Cure forwarding; Volcanic Saurian (Stalker Raptor / Gabbrath) projects a 15y Party Pack Aura.
entries.name: Apex Bond

entries.description: Provides starter Crossbow and bolts at Lv. 10 if empty, full Ammo Recycle, no ranged distance damage penalty, and growing Max HP, Archery/Marksmanship skill, Ranged Accuracy, Snapshot/Rapid Shot, and Store TP while a pet is active.
entries.name: Primeval Pack

entries.description: Eligible Archery and Marksmanship weapon skills heal your active beast for a level-scaled share of its Max HP and grant it a strong burst of Pet TP.
entries.name: Warden's Ration

entries.description: Enhances Rune mastery, triggers elemental discharges on Great Sword swings and weapon skills, and rewards Rune resonance.
entries.name: Runic Brand

entries.description: Unlocks 3-Rune Mastery at Lv. 10+, transforms Vivacious Pulse into a 15s Party AoE heal with Rune-driven boons, enables Runic Lifetap on melee attacks, and projects Regen spells to nearby allies.
entries.name: Sacred Pulse

entries.description: Unlocks 3-Rune Mastery at Lv. 10+, preserves Runes on Swipe, Lunge, Gambit, and Rayke, triggers Runic Riposte on Parry, and enables dual defensive Tank Stances.
entries.name: Runeweft's Ward

entries.description: Elevates Archery to A+ while preserving arrows without consuming them, enables 20y Bow auto-attacks with no point-blank penalty, and powers the Drawn Oisoya and Cosmic Brand combo loop.
entries.name: Oisoya Mastery

entries.description: Requires a Great Katana: empowers 20s Hagakure Iaijutsu Sundering draw-slashes, party-wide Ashura's Edge auras, and Onimaru Blood-Quench Skillchain recovery surges.
entries.name: Onimaru's Command

entries.description: Requires a Great Katana: unlocks multi-charge Mind's Eye counter-anticipation, Mushin Stagger damage deferral, and enhanced Seigan tank mitigation.
entries.name: Ronin's Mushin

entries.description: Unlocks Call Titania, extends Addendum: Black to 2 hours, maintains permanent Ebullience for black magic, and empowers Helix spells with extended 2-hour duration.
entries.name: Heliarch's Wisdom

entries.description: Unlocks Call Eos, extends Addendum: White to 2 hours, accelerates Sublimation charging without HP drain, and grants free 10y AoE coverage on qualifying Cure and Regen spells.
entries.name: Chirurgeon's Grace

entries.description: Projects the 15y Celestial Sanctuary Regen, Refresh, and mitigation aura from your active Avatar, eliminates Avatar perpetuation cost, shortens Blood Pact: Ward recasts, and triggers Starlight Mend party and Avatar heals on Wards and Staff/Club weapon skills.
entries.name: Astral Sanctuary

entries.description: Amplifies Attack, Double Attack, Weapon Skill Damage, and the ferocity of Warrior's offensive abilities.
entries.name: Berserker's Fury

entries.description: Unlocks short-cooldown tactical battle cries and single-stance Warcry sharing starting at Lv. 10.
entries.name: Commander's Tactics

entries.description: Grants Polearm and Size-1 Buckler Mastery, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, charge-based Melee and Spell Brace deflection, and phalanx mitigation.
entries.name: Spartan's Phalanx

entries.description: Unlocks proactive Afflatus Solace at Lv. 10 so single-target Cures apply Solace Ward barriers and mitigation, and empowers Banish, Holy, and weapon skills to recover MP and build Sacred Grace stacks for party Regen.
entries.name: Solace Conduit
